I wrote `component.html` in the folder. It's the 1280px Requests screen inside `#component`, in static HTML and CSS only. I haven't opened it in a browser or run `check:ui`, so the layout is unchecked.

- **Layout:** The page follows the DESIGN.md Screens rules. It sits on white, in a centered 1120px column with 48px above and 32px side padding. "Requests" is on the left in Unbounded Light caps, and the one primary button, "New Request", is on the right.
- **Search and filters:** The "Search requests" field has a visible caps label above it and no placeholder, so no extra text appears. "All" is the selected filter, drawn as a Secondary outline pill. "Open" and "Closed" are Quiet buttons.
- **Table:** It sits in a bordered card. The header uses the label style, rows are 52px with 1px dividers, and every status is an accent-tint pill. Content is exactly what you gave.
- **Self-contained:** I inlined only the tokens it uses from `tokens.css`, so component styles use `var()` throughout and no raw hex.
- **Fonts:** There are no font files in the folder, so Unbounded and Archivo fall back to the system sans-serif stack. The typography will look different once the real fonts load.
